source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
After this model shoots in your Shooting phase, pick 1 enemy unit that at least one attack from its twin macro-accelerator cannon hit this phase. That unit is suppressed until your next turn starts, while this model remains on the battlefield.

Attacks by models in a suppressed unit take −1 to their **Hit rolls**.
